name: io.github.Aruon-AI/reir
title: ARUON Research
description: Sourced, analyst-released CRE site and land screens. Pay by card or USDC on Base or Ethereum.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: The ARUON catalog: every report with its price (or null where it is quoted), whether it can be ordered now, whether it is instant pay, the turnaround, a sample and the terms. The same records as https://reir.aruon.ai/pricing.json. Empty, with a reason, while ordering is closed.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: How well ARUON holds a place for one report: band full_data (24-hour clock where sla_hours is set), area_scan, zip_only or unknown, with the reason. The answer the order page reads. Whether an order can be paid at once depends on the report: market_scan, scout_shortlist_founding and screen_parcel go to checkout only where the band is full_data; tower_sheet and site_search only where area_scan is true (the ordered ring is loaded), whatever the band; market_report on any US ZIP, whatever the band; tower_targets never: an analyst always confirms scope first. Anywhere else an analyst confirms scope before anything is charged; ok=false means the place could not be read. Even on held ground an order can still go to scope review, so create_order's status is the final word.

inputSchema.description: ONE place: state + county_fips, lat + lng, zip, or address.

sku.description: The report the coverage is read for.

address.description: A street address (geocoded once; address lookups are limited per connection).

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Files an order through the same door as the web order form and returns {order_token, status, checkout_url}. status is one of: awaiting_payment: Instant pay: finish checkout at checkout_url. Nothing runs before payment. Work begins at our analyst's go-ahead.; awaiting_scope_review: An analyst confirms scope with the buyer first, then sends the payment link or an invoice. Nothing is charged until then.; awaiting_human_approval: An order filed before 2026-11-04 from an agent operator we had not approved yet: a person approves it before any checkout link. Nothing is charged until then. checkout_url is set only for awaiting_payment. This tool never charges, never starts a report and never releases one. Requires the buyer's consent and paid-engagement acknowledgment, ai_agent_name and agent_operator. Send an idempotency_key and reuse it on any retry: a repeat with the same key and agent_operator returns the first order's token and status (replayed: true) and never files a second order. If create_order answers with a gateway error (502, 503, 504 or 524) or no answer at all, the order may or may not have been filed: retry with the same idempotency_key. Without a key, do not retry at once: wait about a minute and retry once; if the buyer then receives two order mails, they should pay only the link in the newest one and tell ARUON (reply to either mail), and the duplicate is cancelled. Nothing is charged until a checkout link is paid.

sku.description: The report, by its catalog key (list_products / pricing.json).

email.description: The buyer's email. The one confirmation and the report go here; it must be a deliverable address.

consent.description: true: the buyer accepts the Privacy Policy and the SMS terms. Required.

paid_ack.description: true: the buyer acknowledges, verbatim: “I understand this is a paid engagement. After payment, an ARUON analyst checks the order and starts the report; the clock starts at our analyst's go-ahead, not at the card charge.” Required.

geography.description: ONE place. kind=address: {address}; kind=zip: {zip}; kind=county: {state, county_fips}; kind=parcel: {state, county_fips, parcel_id}; kind=pin: {lat, lng} (saved as coordinates, never turned into an address).

use.description: Intended use, for the SKUs that read one (Property Screen, Tower Sheet, Site Search).

notes.description: Anything the analyst should read; longer text is cut at 4,000 characters. Read by a person; it changes nothing automatically.

asking_price.description: The asking price, where the report reads one (Property Screen, Housing Screen).

must.description: Must-have chips for the ring searches (Tower Sheet, Site Search): the catalog's hunt_chips keys; min_acres posts as min_acres=<n>.

nice.description: Nice-to-have chips, same keys. Emphasis only; they filter nothing.

radius_mi.description: Search radius in whole miles, 1–100, for the ring searches. Blank is the default ring.

site_acres.description: Site size the buyer needs, in acres (read by the analyst).

min_acres.description: Minimum lot size in acres; the search applies it as the floor, unless it is also posted as a nice-to-have chip (emphasis only).

agent_operator.description: The organisation that runs the agent. A person checks the first order from an operator before its report is released.

idempotency_key.description: Optional, and recommended: a key you choose for this order (8–128 letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' or '-'; a UUID fits). Send the SAME key when you retry: a repeat with the same key and agent_operator returns the first order's token and status and never files a second order. Keys are kept per agent_operator.

on_behalf_of.description: The principal the agent orders for: a name, or {name, organization, email}.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: The order's status by its order_token: awaiting_payment: Instant pay: finish checkout at checkout_url. Nothing runs before payment. Work begins at our analyst's go-ahead.; awaiting_scope_review: An analyst confirms scope with the buyer first, then sends the payment link or an invoice. Nothing is charged until then.; awaiting_human_approval: An order filed before 2026-11-04 from an agent operator we had not approved yet: a person approves it before any checkout link. Nothing is charged until then.; paid: Paid. The clock starts at our analyst's go-ahead, not at the card charge.; in_production: The report is being built.; in_review: The report is built and an analyst is reading it before release.; delivered: Released by an analyst and sent to the buyer's email.; held: A person at ARUON is looking at the order. Nothing is charged or sent until they act.; received: Received.; closed: Closed. No report will be sent on this order. checkout_url is set only while the order awaits payment.

tools.name: start_crypto_payment
tools.description: For an order awaiting payment: files the payment intake (billing address, role, the wallet the buyer will send from, and acceptance of the terms, refund and privacy documents, and of Schedule C (Crypto Payments) of the Terms of Service with accept_terms, before any code is emailed). For a Ukrainian billing address, billing.region is required: the region's ISO 3166-2 code, e.g. UA-30. Texas sales tax applies. Unless the payment service has already verified the buyer's email, it mails a six-digit code to the HUMAN buyer's own inbox (the order's email), never to you: the person must give you the code for confirm_crypto_payment, and you cannot complete a crypto payment without it. Once a crypto payment starts, the card checkout link is withdrawn: one payment per order. A first crypto order is paid as usual and checked by a person before the report is released. Rails are the ones the payment service has on (get_order_status lists them; network fees are paid by the sender, and a rail whose fees are higher says so there). Nothing is charged here: the buyer sends the payment from their own wallet. Crypto is offered only on some orders (get_order_status carries a crypto block where it is); for any other order this tool answers that crypto is not offered for the order, and nothing changes.

phone.description: The buyer's phone. Required here when the order was placed without one.

accept.description: The buyer accepts the terms, the refund policy and the privacy policy for this payment, and this acknowledgment (hub-ack-2026-11-02-crypto): "I understand this is a paid engagement. After payment, an ARUON analyst checks the order and starts the report; the clock starts at our analyst's go-ahead, not at payment (the card charge or the USDC payment)."

accept_terms.description: Must be true: the buyer has read and accepts Schedule C (Crypto Payments) of ARUON's Terms of Service, version 2026-11-17.1: https://aruon.ai/terms-of-service#schedule-c. Required before the code is emailed and before any payment; a call without it is refused and nothing is filed.

tools.name: confirm_crypto_payment
tools.description: The six-digit code mailed to the human buyer's inbox: ask the person for it; it is never sent to you. Answers with the quote (coin, network, exact amount, address, 20 minutes to send) or the hold and who must act. If the quote expires before a payment arrives, call request_new_quote.

tools.name: request_new_quote
tools.description: For an order whose crypto quote expired before a payment arrived (get_order_status says so): asks for a new quote, at a new exact amount with 20 minutes to send. It is the order page's GET A NEW QUOTE button. Refused while the current quote is still inside its 20 minutes (send against that one), once a payment to the order has been seen, and for an order no longer awaiting payment. No new code is emailed. Nothing is charged here: the buyer sends the payment from their own wallet. For an order crypto is not offered on, this tool answers that crypto is not offered for the order, and nothing changes.
